agentSupport.notes: Immutable never-do floor retained for dev-loop drain mode: the list of actions an agent never takes autonomously (history rewrites, destructive migrations, secrets, external contracts, unrecoverable deletion, deploys, undeclared spend, scope breakout), checked by intent before execution and parked to the escalation queue on a would-trip. Overrides every toggle and preset — no gate set to auto can authorise a rail action. Harvested from the retired APS loop design change #9 / gap G5.
